episodes.title: Pokémon Tabletop - Chronos Core Crisis Prime #17 - 278 - Unbeatable: Infinite Collision
episodes.description:
[Inspired by the incredible fic written by Community member Skwiziks]

Unbeatable Episode 278 - Chronos Core Crisis Prime #17

Seth: "Is everyone ready?"

DJ, floating, partially ethereal: "As ready as we'll ever be. I've got the Eclipse Ball handy for whenever we need to call Marshadow."

Coryne, her entire left side replaced by cybernetics: "You having to absorb all the Ghost-type energy from the Pokemon Tower was super traumatic but I don't think anyone else could have connected to them and gotten Marshadow to agree to help."

DJ: "Yeah, I guess, but after you saved my life going toe-to-toe with  RegiPrime? I had to do something. You lost half of your, well, half your everything!"

Coryne: "Maybe, but it was worth it so I could throw RegiPrime's core at Azure and crush his face. Besides, Bill fixed me up afterwards."

Seth: "The police still wanted to talk to you about that."

Coryne: "They can get in line. Gavin, your sister on track?"

Gavin, adjusting an ornate but highly marketable tokusatsu style wristwatch: "Yeah, she'll make it. Her and Vermillion should be here in a few minutes. As soon as everyone gets here we're going after Deadbones and his army of hive minded dittos. We getting any more backup?"

Seth: "My dad said they'd try, but the league is busy throwing everything they've got at keeping the winged mirages away from Mt Silver."

Gavin: "Oh well, Ava and I can handle it, can't we?" 

Ava cries out in anticipation of glorious battle. The spirits of the world weep at the horror to come.

The group turns at the sounds of footsteps coming rapidly up the stairs. A burly man appears with a cleanly shaven head, full beard, functional but ill fitting tactical gear, and three pokeballs on his belt. It is obvious that beneath his round exterior you will find a densely corded, powerful musculature.

Michael Taub, winded but ready for action: "Dang it if that Graham kid wasn't right on the money. I guess VossCo were a bunch of evil bastards this whole time. They've got a whole gang of goons coming up to wreck our day."

DJ: "Crap, if the league is busy then no one's coming to help. At least not quick enough to matter. What do we do? We'll need time to get the tech set up for the teleport rig."

Coryne: "I'm already helping Poppy and Seth needs to keep Bill on task. DJ is the anchor for the whole plan! Maybe we could..."

Michael Taub, raising a hand: "Stop kid, whaddya need like, twenty minutes?"

Gavin: "Da-, I mean, Mikey, if VossCo sent everything they've got that's too much for you. That's maybe even too much for us. It's too dangerous."

Michael Taub: "Look, champ, you kids gave me my fuckin' life back. If Coryne hadn't almost snapped my spine back in Celadon I probably would have been dead a long time ago. Or worse, still wallowing in my own self-pity with nothing but the next hot meatball sub to look forward to. But I got amnesty, a good job, friends, and a great team of my own. Let the real adults handle this one, okay? I'll get you the time you need, you go save the world."

Gavin is too overwhelmed to respond but Seth steps forward, his hands outstretched: "Here, take three full restores, one for each of your pokemon. You'll need them to be the best distraction you can be."

Michael Taub: "Aw thanks kid."

Coryne, to Seth: "Hey!"

Seth: "What? He volunteered. I'm helping."

Gavin, eyes wet with tears: "You're gonna be okay, right?"

Michael Taub: "That's right. So yeah, I'm gonna go get my ass beat. Again. But I'll get back up. Hey, none of that champ, after you save the world and I'm out of the hospital we'll get ice cream."

Suddenly everyone's phone alarms activate.

Seth, switching his Croc's into sport-mode: "Alright that's go time people. Michael, any messages we should pass along?"

Michael Taub: "Yeah, if you see Karen tell her next time I'm paying for dinner."

The group shares a laugh, a moment of levity before focusing up.

Gavin and Michael Taub share a solemn nod before Gavin turns away and makes a complicated pose with his watch: "Ava let's go! Burst!"

After a brief flash of light a Gavin/Ava hybrid flies out the window.

Seth, DJ, and Coryne rush upstairs, going over the plan one last time as they do so.

Michael Taub takes a deep breath and lets out a brave but shuddering sigh and releases his pokemon. When the red light fades we see a Torterra, Torkoal and a Carracosta. Michael Taub addresses them: "Donny, Raph, Leo, we got one helluva fight ahead of us. You ready?"

The pokemon let out encouraging cries and Michael Taub smiles before his face shifts. The sounds of the VossCo goons are getting close.  He reaches down against the wall: "And how could we forget our final team member, Splinter."

Michael Taub readies his mossberg 590 shockwave, racking a shell into the chamber. His team complete, they head for the stairs. 

He grins, a brittle expression: "Alright fellas, once more into the motherfucking breach."5
